notes.title: Bug Fix Update! Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43270587/0b872284f2383669cb08d716fbcf9cf981d2304e.jpg[/img]
Hi Everyone,

Just a few bug fixes and changes.

- The player now comes to a complete stop when pressing the Oculus Home button.

- Enemy attacks no longer hit when the player enters a warp to advance to the next stage.

- Changed the enemies that appear in the stage where the player fights with a bamboo sword.

Kind Regards
Kento Tomonari
